poll.question: The panther edges toward Mutu. Wesley freezes in terror. Chills whispers steady. Does he hold that calm—or break it to go to Wesley?

options.label: Hold the calm
options.desc: Chills doesn't move. Wesley finds his courage.

options.label: Go to Wesley
options.desc: Chills breaks the vigil and goes to his brother.

options.label: Move now
options.desc: The panther forces the choice. They abandon dawn and go.

in_play.label: Hold camp
in_play.desc: One more day of quiet. Chills heals fully. The three of them stronger together.
